description:
Tools across five UK public registers. All official APIs.

Give an agent a company name and it pulls corporate status, filing compliance, director networks, beneficial ownership chains, disqualification checks, insolvency notices, VAT validation, and property transactions.

tools.name: company_search
tools.description:
Search the Companies House register by company name or keyword.

Returns a paginated list of matching companies with name, number,
status, SIC codes, incorporation date, and registered address.
Use company_profile for the full record once you have the company
number. Re-call with start_index=start_index+items_per_page to
fetch the next page.

query.description: Company name or keyword to search for

company_type.description: Filter by company type (e.g. 'ltd', 'llp'). Omit to search all.

company_status.description: Filter by company status (e.g. 'active', 'dissolved'). Omit to search all.

items_per_page.description: Number of results to return (max 100). Default 20.

address.description: Registered office address as returned by the Companies House API.

sic_codes.description: Standard Industrial Classification codes associated with the company.

description.description: Short upstream description (usually number + status + creation date).

items.description: A single entry in a Companies House search result.
Matching companies. Use the `company_number` field to call company_profile, company_officers, or company_psc for full detail.

query.description: The query string that was searched.

has_more.description: True if more results exist beyond this page. Re-call with start_index=start_index+items_per_page to fetch the next page.

returned.description: Number of items actually returned on this page.

start_index.description: Number of results skipped before this page (upstream start_index).

total_results.description: Total matching companies in Companies House (server-side).

items_per_page.description: Page size requested from the API for this call.

tools.name: company_profile
tools.description:
Fetch the full Companies House profile for a company number.

Returns status, registered address, SIC codes, filing compliance
(overdue accounts and confirmation statement flags), and whether
the company has outstanding charges. Use company_search first to
find the company number.

company_number.description: Companies House company number (8 digits, e.g. '03782379'). Returned by company_search.

overdue.description: True if accounts are past their due date at Companies House.

next_due.description: ISO date the next set of accounts is due.

last_accounts_made_up_to.description: ISO date the most recent filed accounts were made up to.

accounts.description: Accounts filing status and due dates.

has_charges.description: True if the company has outstanding registered charges (secured debt), derived from the /charges endpoint. A due diligence signal.

company_status.description: Current status (active, dissolved, in liquidation, etc.).

overdue.description: True if the confirmation statement is past its due date.

next_due.description: ISO date the next confirmation statement is due.

confirmation_statement.description: Confirmation statement filing status and next due date.

registered_office_address.description: Registered office address as returned by Companies House.

tools.name: company_officers
tools.description:
Fetch active officers for a Companies House company number.

Returns directors, secretaries, and other active officers with
appointment dates, nationality, and country of residence.
Resigned officers are excluded. Pagination is handled internally —
do NOT pass items_per_page or start_index; this tool takes only
company_number.

start_index.description: Ignored — all officers are returned in one call.

company_number.description: Companies House company number (8 digits, e.g. '03782379'). Returned by company_search.

items_per_page.description: Ignored — pagination is handled internally. Only accepted to avoid call failures.

name.description: Officer name as recorded at CH.

links.description: Upstream relational links (e.g. officer profile URL).

resigned_on.description: Date of resignation if resigned, otherwise null.

date_of_birth.description: Partial date of birth (month/year) as returned by CH.

appointment_count.description: Total number of other active appointments held by this officer, or null if unavailable. The Companies House officer list endpoint does not include this count; a separate per-officer call is required to populate it.

items.description: A single officer (director, secretary, etc.) of a company.

include_resigned.description: Whether resigned officers were included in this result.

high_appointment_count_flag.description: Number of active officers with 10+ total appointments, or null if appointment counts were not fetched. Non-zero values are a nominee/phoenix director risk signal.

tools.name: company_psc
tools.description:
Fetch Persons with Significant Control (beneficial ownership) for a company.

Returns PSC entries with natures of control, nationality, and
country of residence. Flags overseas corporate PSC entries as a
beneficial ownership risk signal. Returns an explanatory note for
widely-held PLCs with no registrable PSC.

company_number.description: Companies House company number (8 digits, e.g. '03782379'). Returned by company_search.

ceased_on.description: Date PSC status ceased, if applicable.

notified_on.description: Date notified as a PSC (ISO YYYY-MM-DD).

identification.description: Identification block for corporate PSCs: place_registered, registration_number, country_registered, legal_authority, etc.

natures_of_control.description: List of 'nature of control' descriptors (e.g. 'ownership-of-shares-75-to-100-percent'). Individual entries may be truncated to 300 characters each.

country_of_residence.description: Declared country of residence for individual PSCs.

items.description: A single Person with Significant Control record.

note.description: Explanatory note when total=0. Typical for widely-held listed PLCs where no single person or entity holds 25%+ of shares or voting rights.

total.description: Total PSC entries returned for this company.

overseas_corporate_psc_flag.description: Number of corporate PSCs registered outside the UK. Non-zero values indicate an offshore beneficial ownership chain.

tools.name: charity_search
tools.description:
Search the Charity Commission register of England and Wales by name or keyword.

Returns matching charities with registration number, status, and
registration date. Use charity_profile for full details once you
have the charity number. The upstream `searchCharityName` endpoint
returns the full list in one shot — pagination is applied
client-side via offset/limit.

limit.description: Max items to return in this page. Default 20; raise to 100 for bulk views.

query.description: Charity name or keyword to search for

offset.description: Number of items to skip before this page. Default 0.

limit.description: Max items requested for this page.

offset.description: Number of items skipped before this page (client-side).

has_more.description: True if more items may exist beyond this page. Re-call with offset=offset+returned to continue.

returned.description: Items actually returned on this page.

reg_status.description: Registration status code as returned upstream: 'R' registered, 'RM' removed.

charity_number.description: Charity Commission registration number. Pass to charity_profile for the full record.

items.description: A single hit in a Charity Commission name search.

tools.name: charity_profile
tools.description:
Fetch the full Charity Commission profile for a charity number.

Returns trustees, latest income/expenditure, insolvency flags,
governing document type, classifications, and countries of operation.
Use charity_search first to find the charity number.

charity_number.description: Charity Commission registration number (e.g. '1234567'). Returned by charity_search.

address.description: Registered address of the charity (joined address lines).

insolvent.description: True if the charity is flagged as insolvent.

latest_income.description: Latest filed annual income in GBP.

trustee_names.description: Trustees on record. Truncated to 30 entries.

who_what_where.description: Who/What/Where classification entries. The list may be truncated truncated to 50 entries.

in_administration.description: True if the charity is in administration.

latest_expenditure.description: Latest filed annual expenditure in GBP.

who_what_where_total.description: Total classification entries upstream before truncation.

charity_co_reg_number.description: Companies House number for charities also registered as companies (Charitable Incorporated Organisations, etc.).

countries_of_operation.description: Countries the charity operates in (capped at 10 upstream).

trustee_names_truncated.description: True if the trustee list was truncated.

who_what_where_truncated.description: True if the classification list was truncated.

tools.name: disqualified_search
tools.description:
Check whether a named individual is banned from acting as a UK company director.

Use this tool when asked to check disqualified, banned, or barred directors.
Query must be an individual's name (e.g. "Richard Howson") — NOT a company
name, which always returns zero results.

Returns names, dates of birth, disqualification period snippets, and
officer IDs that can be used with disqualified_profile for full details.

query.description: Name of the person to search for

address.description: Last known address of the disqualified officer.

snippet.description: Upstream match snippet highlighting query terms.

officer_id.description: Companies House officer ID extracted from the self link. Pass to disqualified_profile for the full disqualification record.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth as returned by the search API.

items.description: A single hit in a disqualified officers search.

has_more.description: True if more items may exist beyond this page. Re-call with start_index=start_index+items_per_page to continue.

returned.description: Items actually returned on this page.

total_results.description: Total matching records upstream at Companies House.

tools.name: disqualified_profile
tools.description:
Fetch the full disqualification record for a director by officer ID.

Returns all disqualification orders: reason, Act/section cited,
disqualification period, and associated company names. Use
disqualified_search first to find the officer ID.

officer_id.description: Companies House officer ID. Returned by disqualified_search.
Companies House officer ID looked up.

officer_kind.description: Which CH endpoint returned the record: 'natural' (individual) or 'corporate' (legal entity).

reason.description: Reason block as returned upstream: act, section, description_identifier, article, etc.

address.description: Address on record at the time of the order.

heard_on.description: Date the order was heard, when provided.

company_names.description: Companies associated with this disqualification. The list may be truncated to 20 entries.

undertaken_on.description: Date the undertaking was given, when provided.

last_variation.description: Details of the last variation of this order, if any.

disqualified_from.description: Start date of the disqualification period.

disqualified_until.description: End date of the disqualification period.

company_names_total.description: Total number of companies originally attached to this order before truncation (may equal `len(company_names)`).

company_names_truncated.description: True if the company_names list was truncated to max_companies.

items.description: A single disqualification order attached to a disqualified director.

disqualifications.description: All disqualification orders attached to this officer.

tools.name: land_title_search
tools.description:
Search HM Land Registry Price Paid Index by postcode or address.

Returns up to 10 recent sale transactions for the postcode: price,
date, address, property type, and tenure (Freehold/Leasehold).
Covers England and Wales only. Postcode gives the most reliable
results — a full address is also accepted and the postcode is
extracted automatically.

address_or_postcode.description: UK property address or postcode. Postcode is most reliable: e.g. 'NG1 1AB'. Full address also accepted.

total.description: Number of Price Paid transactions returned. Capped at 10 by the upstream SPARQL query.

postcode.description: Normalised UK postcode extracted from the input.

paon.description: Primary addressable object name (house number or name).

property_type.description: Property type label extracted from the HMLR URI (e.g. 'Terraced', 'Semi Detached', 'Flat').

items.description: A single Price Paid transaction for a property.

transactions.description: Recent Price Paid transactions for the postcode, sorted newest first.

tools.name: gazette_notice
tools.description:
Fetch the full legal wording of a Gazette notice by numeric notice ID.

Returns the complete JSON-LD linked-data record for the notice: parties,
legal basis, court, and full text. Use gazette_insolvency first to find
notice_numeric_id values.

notice_id.description: Numeric Gazette notice ID. Returned as notice_numeric_id by gazette_insolvency.

tools.name: gazette_insolvency
tools.description:
Search The Gazette's insolvency notice index by entity name.

Searches the Gazette's insolvency endpoint which covers corporate
notice codes: winding-up orders (2443), administration orders (2448),
liquidator appointments (2452), striking-off notices (2460), and more.
Results are sorted by severity — winding-up orders and administration
orders appear first.

Each result includes a notice_numeric_id. Read the full legal wording
via the notice://{notice_numeric_id} resource.

The Gazette is the official UK public record. A notice here means
the event has been formally published and is legally effective.

end_date.description: Filter notices up to this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

entity_name.description: Company or individual name to search for in Gazette insolvency notices

max_notices.description: Cap on notices returned, applied after severity/date sort. Default 20. The Gazette insolvency feed returns up to 100 results per search — raise to 100 to see the full set.

notice_type.description: Filter by notice code (e.g. '2441' winding-up petition, '2443' winding-up order, '2448' administration order, '2460' striking-off). Omit to search all.

content.description: Brief notice excerpt from the search feed (HTML stripped). For full legal wording read notice://{notice_numeric_id}.

severity.description: Internal severity score 0-10. Higher = more serious (10 = Winding-Up Order, 9 = Administration Order / Receiver, 0 = unclassified).

notice_code.description: Gazette notice code (e.g. '2443' winding-up order, '2448' administration order).

notice_numeric_id.description: Numeric notice ID. Read full notice content via the notice://{notice_numeric_id} resource.

items.description: A single corporate insolvency notice from The Gazette.

notices.description: Matching notices, sorted by severity (desc) then date (desc).

end_date.description: Upper bound of the date range filter, if any.

start_date.description: Lower bound of the date range filter, if any.

total_notices.description: Total notices returned after deduplication, sorting, and cap.

max_notices_cap.description: The max_notices cap applied. Upstream may have more matching notices.

notice_type_filter.description: Notice code filter applied, or null if all codes searched.

tools.name: vat_validate
tools.description:
Validate a UK VAT number against the HMRC register.

Returns the trading name and address as registered with HMRC for VAT
purposes. The VAT-registered trading address often differs from the
Companies House registered address — that discrepancy is a due
diligence signal worth noting.

vat_number.description: UK VAT registration number. Accepts: 'GB123456789', '123456789', 'GB 123 456 789'. GB prefix and spaces normalised automatically.

valid.description: True if HMRC confirmed the VAT number is currently registered. False means HMRC returned 404 (not registered / deregistered).

vat_number.description: Canonical VAT number in 'GB<9 digits>' format.

trading_name.description: Trading name registered with HMRC for VAT. Compare with the Companies House name — discrepancies are a due diligence signal.

registered_address.description: VAT-registered trading address. May differ from the Companies House registered office address.

consultation_number.description: HMRC consultation reference number for this lookup.

tools.name: search
tools.description:
Search across all UK due diligence registers simultaneously.

Searches Companies House, Charity Commission, disqualified directors,
and Gazette insolvency notices in parallel. Returns a list of result
IDs — use fetch with each ID to retrieve the full record.

query.description: Company name, charity name, director name, or keyword to search for across all UK due diligence registers

tools.name: fetch
tools.description:
Fetch the full record for an ID returned by search.

Routes by prefix to the appropriate register:
- company:{number} → Companies House full profile
- charity:{number} → Charity Commission full profile
- disqualification:{officer_id} → Disqualified director full record
- notice:{notice_id} → Gazette notice full legal text

id.description: Prefixed record ID returned by search. Format: company:{number}, charity:{number}, disqualification:{officer_id}, or notice:{notice_id}

tools.name: list_prompts
tools.description:
List all available prompts.

Returns JSON with prompt metadata including name, description,
and optional arguments.

tools.name: get_prompt
tools.description:
Get a prompt by name with optional arguments.

Returns the rendered prompt as JSON with a messages array.
Arguments should be provided as a dict mapping argument names
to values.

name.description: The name of the prompt to get

prompts.name: due_diligence
prompts.description: Full due diligence check on a UK company across all registers.

prompts.name: charity_due_diligence
prompts.description: Due diligence check on a UK registered charity.

prompts.name: director_check
prompts.description: Check whether a named individual is disqualified as a UK company director.
